highlights.title: Put treatment (+) button in iPhone Duo side rail
changes: The treatment (+) button is moved from bottom center into the side tab rail on iPhone Duo.
All other iPhones keep the original bottom-centre button.

sources.title: gordolio/Trio#1654: Put the treatment button in the side tab bar on iPhone Duo

includedPullRequests.title: Put the treatment button in the side tab bar on iPhone Duo
includedPullRequests.body: On iPhone Duo, the tab bar can lay out as a vertical rail down the side of the screen. Trio draws its treatment (+) button over the tab bar at a fixed spot, bottom centre, so on the Duo the button floats over the home screen cards and the rail is left with an empty slot. ## Summary ```diff GeometryReader { geo in treatmentButton - .position(x: geo.size.width / 2, y: geo.size.height - 52) + .position(treatmentButtonPosition(in: geo)) } ``` ```text treatmentButtonPosition(in: geo) if iPhone and the safe area has a side inset // vertical bars add side insets rail's empty slot: 48 pt in from that edge, 156 pt up else bottom centre, 52 pt up // unchanged ``` SwiftUI's `tabBarPlacement` still reports `.bottomBar` for the rail, so it can't tell the two apart. Apple documents that vertical bars provide leading and trailing safe-area insets, and Trio's iPhone layout is otherwise portrait-only, so other iPhones never have side insets. ## Evidence iPhone Duo simulator, closed (outer display): | Before | After | |---|---| | | | Open (inner display): | Landscape: side rail | Portrait: bottom bar, unchanged | |---|---| | | | Also checked: - On both Duo displays, the button's centre is within 0.5 pt of the rail icons' centre line and the empty slot's centre (measured on the screenshots). - Forced right-to-left: the rail stays on the physical right, which is the leading side, and the button follows it. - iPhone 17 on iOS 26.5: the button is still centred in the bottom bar. - Tested in the simulator only (Xcode 27.1, iOS 27.1), not on a real iPhone Duo. **Blast Radius:** layout Only the + position moves, and only on iPhones whose safe area has a side inset: today that's iPhone Duo with its tab bar down the side. It builds with Xcode 26.2 (this PR's CI) and Xcode 27.1. The 48 pt and 156 pt offsets are measured from the Duo simulator, are the same on both displays, and would need re-measuring if Apple changes the rail's metrics.
